SELECT quarter_year, quarter_num, CONCAT(quarter_year, '-Q', quarter_num) as quarter, SUM(isa_profit) as isa_profit, SUM(general_tax) as general_tax, SUM(tax_saved) as tax_saved, SUM(interest_income) as interest_income, SUM(total_tax) as total_tax, SUM(net_income) as net_income, SUM(total_tax) - SUM(general_tax) + SUM(tax_saved) as tax_difference, CASE WHEN SUM(total_tax) > 0 THEN (SUM(tax_saved) / SUM(total_tax)) * 100 ELSE 0 END as tax_saving_rate FROM ( SELECT YEAR(created_at) as quarter_year, QUARTER(created_at) as quarter_num, isa_profit, general_tax, tax_saved, 0 as interest_income, 0 as total_tax, 0 as net_income FROM isa_tax_saving_history WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{quarters} QUARTER)
UNION ALL
SELECT YEAR(created_at) as quarter_year, QUARTER(created_at) as quarter_num, 0 as isa_profit, 0 as general_tax, 0 as tax_saved, interest_income, total_tax, net_income FROM deposit_tax_saving_history WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{quarters} QUARTER) ) combined_data GROUP BY quarter_year, quarter_num ORDER BY quarter_year ASC, quarter_num ASC
